name: Motif Match
summary: A truck-art memory game: flip painted cards, match peacocks, kites and kettles before the horn
about: A memory card game dressed like a painted truck tailboard, with a navy board in yellow, pink and green bands, spinning rosettes and a fringe of swinging chains and bells. Twelve hand-drawn motifs (peacock, parrot, rose, fish, eye, moon, kettle, sun, lotus, butterfly, winged heart and kite) flip in 3D, and every pair you find flies onto the collected shelf. Good as a playful corner for a culture, travel or kids site.
how: A demo plays by itself on load; press Play or click any card to start your own game.
Turn two cards at a time; a pair stays face up and a miss shakes and turns back.
Pairs in a row build a streak up to x5, and seconds left at the end become bonus points.
Boards grow from 6 to 12 pairs over four levels, then night-haul levels have less time and hidden cards that swap places.
Arrow keys move between cards and Enter or Space turns one; P pauses and covers the board, R restarts.
Your best score is kept; with reduced motion the chains stay still and cards turn without dealing or flying.
